all_found.desc: [BUG] The stale-but-gated path runs only when PlanHookInstall has no conflicts; an earlier metareview hook dir that still holds the gate plus a hand-added hook records a migration conflict, so gitGateStatus reports Installed:false although that dir still gates git push. setup --check reports the push gate absent and the Stop-hook remediation claims nothing stops an unreviewed finish.

rejected.desc: [BUG] TestMovingTheMainCheckoutKeepsLinkedWorktreesGated runs git commit under isolatedGit, which sets HOME to a temp dir and ignores system config, so git has no user identity. The test fails in CI (exit 128) wherever git cannot infer an identity, failing the PR's test job.
